notes: Indira Gandhi Hospital Kavaratti is the UT-level referral hospital — listed at https://lakshadweep.gov.in/public-utility/indira-gandhi-hospital-kavaratti/ with email lk-dmh@nic.in. Phone 04896-262240 / 04896-262794 surfaced in govt directory search but the dedicated facility page only publishes the Director Health Services email — kept phones out of payload to avoid life-safety risk on mismatch. As the only government referral hospital for the entire UT (sole tertiary capability before airlift to Kochi), ER capability assumed true. Police Control Kavaratti 04896-263100 confirmed on https://lakshadweep.gov.in/disaster-management/. SP Office Kavaratti 04896-262258 confirmed on https://lakshadweep.gov.in/departments-new/police-department/ (single SP for entire UT — no district structure). Deputy Collector Kavaratti 04896-263716 / 262252, mobile 9447919033 confirmed in disaster-management table. Coast Guard 1554 is national MRCC number — critical for Lakshadweep where major emergencies require helicopter evacuation (Pawan Hans lease) or Coast Guard evac to Kochi/Thiruvananthapuram. Pharmacy/mechanic/tow/EN-doctor not on any .gov.in page → null. Honest scarcity reflects single-UT thin infrastructure.

name: Bangaram

notes: Bangaram is uninhabited — no permanent population, no government hospital, no police station, no PHC. NOT listed on https://lakshadweep.gov.in/public-utility-category/hospitals/ — confirmed absence. Tourism page https://lakshadweep.gov.in/tourist-place/bangaram/ describes it as 'the only uninhabited island resort in Lakshadweep'. All emergencies route through Agatti (8 km north, the parent inhabited island with airstrip + CHC + police station). On-site only Bangaram Beach Resort seasonal staff — resort phone deliberately not published as it varies by operator / lease cycle (not a .gov.in source). Deputy Collector Agatti 9447822714 is the responsible administrative officer per https://lakshadweep.gov.in/disaster-management/. Coast Guard 1554 critical — Bangaram emergencies typically need boat-to-Agatti then airlift. Honest scarcity entirely expected: police_station / police_address / pharmacy / mechanic / tow / guesthouse / EN-doctor all null. hospital_has_er null because CHC Agatti ER capability unverified.
